versions.changelog:
Initial release: Modern, comprehensive responsive design techniques in CSS and React.

- Includes patterns for container queries, fluid typography, CSS Grid/Flexbox, and mobile-first breakpoints.
- Provides fluid spacing and typography scales using clamp().
- Features responsive images (art direction with <picture> and srcset) and navigation components.
- Demonstrates responsive grids and tables, with Tailwind CSS-ready code samples.
- Guides on common adaptive design scenarios for React and CSS.
